home.title: Plan your Umrah with a clear, itemised estimate
home.intro: Choose your dates, travelers, rooms and hotels. We price every night from supplier rate sheets we have published, show you where each price comes from, and mark anything we cannot price yet as "Request a quote".
home.step1: Enter your trip: dates, nights in Makkah and Madinah, travelers and rooms.
home.step2: See an estimate with each hotel night and visa listed, in PKR with SAR beside it.
home.step3: Request a quote. Our team checks availability with the supplier and replies.

estimate.a: No. It is an estimate from the supplier rate sheets we have published. The final price is in the quote our team sends after checking with the supplier.

requestQuote.q: Why does part of my estimate say "Request a quote"?
requestQuote.a: We only show prices we have from a published rate sheet. If a hotel has no rate for your dates, a hotel is priced "on booking", or a service has no rate sheet yet, we leave it out of the total and ask you to request a quote.

expiry.q: How long is an estimate valid?
expiry.a: The estimate shows its expiry time: 72 hours, or the end of the supplier rate sheet if that comes first.

change.a: Yes. Rates can change without notice until the supplier confirms your booking.

currency.a: Suppliers price in Saudi riyals (SAR). We show Pakistani rupees (PKR) with SAR beside each amount, using the exchange rate shown on your estimate.

documents.q: Do you collect passport or CNIC numbers online?
documents.a: No. This website never asks for passport numbers, CNIC numbers or card details.

booking.q: Does requesting a quote book my trip?
booking.a: No. A quote request asks our team to check availability and prices. Nothing is reserved until you agree and the supplier confirms.
